about: Task phrasings mapped to the capability that should rank first for a Python project. 'tuning' was written alongside the capability terms; 'heldout' was written by a separate agent that saw only capability titles, before ranking changes, and was scored only in aggregate. Used by tests/routing.test.mjs and scripts/routing-eval.mjs. The held-out misses were printed once on 2026-10-10 after wave 9; ranking changes made after that need a fresh held-out set to be measured honestly.
